headline: US Equities Decline 3.7% as Markets Price In Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations
summary: Wall Street benchmark indices dropped 3.7% to a six-month low as investors increased bets on further Federal Reserve interest rate increases. Bond strategists expect the yield curve to flatten further as the central bank maintains its stance.
why: US equity benchmarks dictate global market sentiment, while Federal Reserve interest rate policy directly influences worldwide borrowing costs and asset valuations.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: US equity benchmarks declined 3.7% as markets reassessed interest rate expectations.
